coverage_override.reason: The control condition, Token Tribute cost, choose/mass-destroy/then-destroy operation, and HOPT are parts of one Quick Effect.

effects.printed_clause: While controlling Dysmandr, Tribute a Protogenic Essence Token, choose an Effect Monster; destroy all other Effect Monsters sharing Type, Attribute, Level, ATK or DEF except Dysmandr, then destroy the chosen monster. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: A hard-once-per-turn Quick Effect checks face-up Dysmandr, Tributes the required releasable Token as cost, chooses and relates a face-up Effect Monster without targeting, builds the five-characteristic matching group excluding Dysmandr and the chosen card, and now destroys the chosen card only after at least one other matching monster was successfully destroyed.

official_references.matched_structure: Compares monster Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF to establish shared characteristics.
Builds and processes a non-targeting mass on-field group during resolution.

effects.issue: Fixed: the 'then' destruction of the chosen monster is now gated on successful destruction of at least one card in the required first group.
